name: Elevation Foods
old_description: Great food is our reputation. We partner with leading retailers and operators to bring exceptional food concepts to life. We are a passionate team of experts in culinary, R&D, marketing, manufacturing, and sourcing with a track record of innovative food ideas that delight customers, drive growth, and elevate brands.
about:
Elevation Foods operates from its headquarters in Knoxville, Tennessee, with redundant manufacturing facilities in Danvers, Massachusetts, and Boston, Massachusetts. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year or ownership structure.

The company produces a range of prepared foods including savory baked goods such as quiches, frittatas, and chicken pot pies, as well as dips and spreads, deli salads, and sous vide potatoes. Its capabilities span kettle cooking, baking, mixing, and filling across both refrigerated and frozen formats, with packaging options from single-serve retail to bulk foodservice sizes. Two USDA-inspected plants provide redundant capacity for national and regional distribution.

Elevation Foods serves foodservice operators and retail channels, including grocery and club retailers. It offers contract manufacturing and private label services, developing custom products for foodservice menus and scaling existing recipes for production. Customers range from deli and sandwich bars to hot bar operators seeking labor-saving, consistent prepared foods.

The company emphasizes a collaborative, culinary-led approach, positioning its R&D and commercialization teams as partners to bring client concepts to shelf. Food safety is a stated priority, with daily USDA inspection, SQF certification, HACCP compliance, and FDA governance. Redundant facilities are cited as a differentiator for supply reliability.
